about: Decisions made by a person. tools/build_pages.py applies them everywhere (song histories, play counts, First/Last, This Day, show pages) and stops with an error if a First/Last card disagrees with a song ruling. Default rule without a ruling: JerryBase wins. Shows JerryBase doesn't list as public Grateful Dead concerts are marked by tools/merge_jerrybase.py; a 'shows' ruling here overrides that.

1967-01-01.reason: The tape filed under this date is an undated studio reel, not the Panhandle show.

1967-04-01.reason: The tape filed under this date is a radio program (records by other artists and talk), not this show.

1978-11-17.reason: The tape filed under this date is an acoustic set from another night; JerryBase places the band at the Uptown Theatre in Chicago.

1966-01-08.reason: The Fillmore Acid Test tape mixes in music from other events: its Caution is from 2/25/66 (Empire Studios) and its King Bee from 3/19/66 (Carthay Studios), per JerryBase and a detailed archive.org review (Jan 1, 2026). JerryBase lists only the Star-Spangled Banner for 1/8/66.

1967-01-27.reason: The tape filed under 1/27/67 is disputed: several archive.org reviewers place it in late 1967 (songs the band didn't play until later, different gear). JerryBase lists the show with no setlist.

Mama Tried.reason: Ruled Nov 17, 2026: the first Grateful Dead performance is 6/20/69 (JerryBase). The 6/11/69 California Hall show was Bobby Ace and the Cards from the Bottom of the Deck.

Nobody's Fault But Mine.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: only standalone performances count. JerryBase lists it 42 more times as a jam inside other songs (a segue in and out, usually Truckin' > Nobody's Fault > ...); those are shown on the song page but not counted.

Caution (Do Not Stop On The Tracks).reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: the Last is 5/11/72. The later JerryBase listings are Caution jams inside other songs; shown, not counted. First stays 2/25/66: the 1/8/66 Acid Test tape's Caution is really from 2/25/66 (JerryBase; archive.org review).

Morning Dew.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: the 1/27/67 tape that has Morning Dew is disputed (reviewers place it in late 1967), so JerryBase's 3/18/67 stands.

Born Cross-Eyed.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: First is JerryBase's 1/17/68 (on tape). The SetList Program's 6/8/67 (Cafe au Go-Go, no tape) stays on the card as an unconfirmed listing, not counted.

Casey Jones.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: First is JerryBase's 6/20/69 (Fillmore East; the song isn't on the surviving tape, so the card plays 6/22/69). The SetList Program's 5/23/69 (no tape) stays on the card as an unconfirmed listing, not counted.

Cream Puff War.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: Last is JerryBase's 4/28/67 (Stockton Ballroom, no tape, so the card plays 3/18/67). The SetList Program's 6/8/67 (no tape) stays on the card as an unconfirmed listing, not counted.

Funiculi Funicula.label: tease
Funiculi Funicula.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: never played as a full song, so the cards are labeled First tease and Last tease. Teases don't count as plays.

It's A Man's World.reason: Ruled Nov 19, 2026: JerryBase's 11/12/70 stands. The surviving tape of that show doesn't have the song, so the card plays 8/18/70 (the latest tape that does) and notes the real date.
